questions.prompt: When the heap grows beyond k points, what should happen?

choices.label: Remove its farthest point.
choices.feedback: Discarding only the farthest of k+1 candidates keeps k closest points seen so far.

choices.label: Remove its nearest point.
choices.feedback: Discarding only the farthest of k+1 candidates keeps k closest points seen so far.

choices.label: Discard every point tied with the newest point.
choices.feedback: Discarding only the farthest of k+1 candidates keeps k closest points seen so far.
